issues.where: upload slab, especially its lower-right edge; also visible in set-A-08.png and set-A-10.png
issues.what: The slab has a beveled silhouette, but its blue-gray interior shows nearly the same stipple across the face and no clear separation between the glass, the dashed markings, and the substrate. It reads as a textured gray panel rather than glass over a layer.
issues.fix: Separate the glass and backing, put the dashed rule below the glass, and add a narrow grazing reflection and slight displacement of the backing texture through the bevel.

issues.where: center pose, right arm over the Resume sheet
issues.what: The arm starts with a blunt rounded end in the middle of the paper, with no visible connection back to the arrow. It looks as if it goes through the sheet or floats on top of it.
issues.fix: Route that arm continuously from the arrow around the paper edge, with the hand wrapping the sheet and a tight contact shadow at the grip.

issues.where: shredder mount immediately below the glass and the hanging paper output
issues.what: The roller has convincing teeth and metal shading, but its exposed rectangular back bracket reads as a frame laid onto the page, with no visible pocket or fasteners. Several strips read as bands of repeating light and dark blocks rather than bent paper ribbons.
issues.fix: Recess the frame into a cutout with a tight mounting seam and end fasteners. Model the strips as continuous curled ribbons with exposed edges and let their highlights follow the bends.

issues.where: fourth arrow's puncture and fifth arrow's lower face; similar puncture on the far-right arrow in set-A-06.png
issues.what: The puncture has a rim, but its center reads as a solid gray disk with no trace of the page showing through. The deformation crack on the adjacent arrow reads as a fine surface line without an opening or lit edge.
issues.fix: Cut an actual opening with an asymmetric inner wall and show the page texture in shadow through it. Give the fracture a slight separation and a thin lit lip.

issues.what: The button has a bevel and a dark underside, but the uninterrupted slab around it gives it the look of an applied badge rather than a control fitted into the glass.
issues.fix: Add a shallow pocket and a narrow reveal around the cap, with an asymmetric contact seam and a restrained highlight on the cap curvature.
